minutes.headline: Planning Board approved flood-plain and multi-dwelling special permits for three properties; two hearings continued for lack of quorum.
minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Planning Board approved a lot-line land swap on Page Street and special permits for flood-plain work at 881 Flat Hill Road and 18 Oak Ridge Road and for a multiple-dwelling rebuild at 27 Fire Road 15A, all with standard administrative conditions. Hearings for 10 Parmenter Road and New West Townsend Road were continued to September 14th because a board member's absence created a quorum risk for the special permits involved, and the board discussed a possible submission-deadline policy and zoning bylaw cleanup items for the November special town meeting.

what_happened.line: Planning Board approved special permits for flood-plain reconstruction at 881 Flat Hill Road and 18 Oak Ridge Road, and a multi-dwelling rebuild at 27 Fire Road 15A.
Hearings for 10 Parmenter Road and New West Townsend Road were continued to September 14th after a board member's absence created a quorum risk.
The board also endorsed a lot-line land swap between two Page Street properties.

The board discussed requiring applicant materials by noon the Thursday before a meeting, and flagged zoning bylaw items -- including a possible removal of the multiple-dwelling approval provision and a four-dwelling cap on shared driveways -- for the November special town meeting.

why_it_matters: Three properties got special-permit approval with standard conditions, clearing the way for flood-plain reconstruction and a multi-dwelling rebuild to proceed.
Neighbors and applicants for the Parmenter Road and New West Townsend Road projects have their hearings pushed to September 14th rather than decided tonight.
A proposed submission-deadline policy and zoning bylaw changes headed toward the November special town meeting could change how future permit applications are handled and what residents vote on.
